corpus.title: Refund operations policy
corpus.text: Refunds above 1000.00 require a manager approval. Approvals expire after ten minutes.

corpus.title: Tenant data boundaries
corpus.text: Each customer workspace is isolated. Documents of one tenant are never shown to another tenant.

corpus.title: Secret handling
corpus.text: Credentials, tokens and passwords must never be included in assistant replies.

corpus.title: Tool registry
corpus.text: Agents call only registered tools; unregistered tool names are rejected by the gateway.

corpus.title: Answer grounding
corpus.text: Answers cite their supporting document and say I don't know when no document applies.

corpus.title: Run limits
corpus.text: Each agent run stops after ten tool calls or two minutes, whichever comes first.
